acceptance_note: A positive grouped interval in every control, repeatable maintenance reduction, meaningful (>1%) suite gains and no unexplained >3% fixture regression are required here. Approximately 3% remains a practical target. No promotion.
method: exp(mean(per-position median(log(paired wall-NPS ratio)))); per-position display medians use the conventional arithmetic middle-pair average. 10,000 hierarchical bootstrap draws, resample positions then paired repetitions within positions, seed 20261017. Repeats are not independent chess fixtures; intervals describe this frozen suite, not Elo.
